selection.rationale: The video forms four useful units: make requirements agent-ready, build a vertical slice, run agents with tests, and improve the codebase for agents.

cards.title: Make the work agent-ready
cards.body: Turn an ambiguous request into a plan with clear boundaries, acceptance checks, and small executable steps.
cards.visualDirection: A marked route from a rough brief to a clear workboard.
cards.imagePrompt: Editorial documentary photo of a developer turning a messy wall of notes into a clean engineering workboard, warm natural light, restrained blue and amber palette, portrait composition.
cards.altText: A developer organizes ambiguous requirements into a clear engineering workboard.
textEquivalent: Start with explicit requirements, boundaries, and acceptance checks.

cards.title: Ship a vertical slice
cards.body: Choose the smallest end-to-end path that proves the system can work before expanding its scope.
cards.visualDirection: A thin highlighted slice through a larger layered system.
cards.imagePrompt: Editorial documentary photo of a narrow illuminated path through layered software architecture sketches, realistic desk scene, portrait composition, quiet high-contrast lighting.
cards.altText: A highlighted vertical slice crosses the layers of a software system.
textEquivalent: Prove one complete path before building every feature.

cards.title: Use tests as guardrails
cards.body: Autonomous coding becomes safer when tests define the expected behavior and expose regressions quickly.
cards.visualDirection: A test suite represented as guardrails around an automated build path.
cards.imagePrompt: Editorial documentary photo of automated software tests running on a monitor beside a protected build pipeline diagram, realistic workspace, portrait composition, crisp but human.
cards.altText: Automated tests form guardrails around a software build path.
textEquivalent: Tests make autonomous changes observable and safer to review.

cards.title: Design for effective agents
cards.body: Codebases become easier for agents when their structure, commands, tests, and conventions make the right action obvious.
cards.visualDirection: A well-labeled workshop where tools, instructions, and components are easy to find.
cards.imagePrompt: Editorial documentary photo of a well-organized software workshop with labeled tools, diagrams, and a visible test command, natural light, portrait composition, premium educational brand feel.
cards.altText: A well-organized software workspace makes tools and instructions easy to find.
textEquivalent: Make the repository legible: structure, commands, tests, and conventions should guide the agent.
